test.create_query: CREATE TABLE rf_nullable_left ( k_no_nulls Nullable(UInt64), k_low_nulls Nullable(UInt64), k_many_nulls Nullable(UInt64), payload UInt64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE rf_nullable_right ( k Nullable(UInt64), kind UInt8 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE rf_lc_nullable_left ( k LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), payload UInt64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE rf_lc_nullable_right ( k LowCardinality(Nullable(String)) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO rf_nullable_left SELECT toNullable(number % 1000000), if(number % 100 = 0, NULL, number % 1000000), if(number % 2 = 0, NULL, number % 1000000), number FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO rf_nullable_right SELECT if(number = 0, NULL, number), 1 FROM numbers(101)
INSERT INTO rf_nullable_right SELECT if(number = 0, NULL, number), 2 FROM numbers(10001)
INSERT INTO rf_lc_nullable_left SELECT if(number % 20 = 0, NULL, concat('key_', toString(number % 100000))), number FROM numbers(5000000)
INSERT INTO rf_lc_nullable_right SELECT if(number = 0, NULL, concat('key_', toString(number))) FROM numbers(5001)
